author: Statius Müller, 1776

points.en: broad black mask with buff crown sides and supercilium

art.subject: Blue-winged Pitta (Pitta moluccensis), adult: crown with broad buff-brown sides divided by a black central crown stripe; a broad black mask from the bill through the eye to the nape; chin and throat white; mantle, back and scapulars green; wing coverts and rump shining cobalt-blue; flight feathers black with a large white patch at the base of the primaries; breast and flanks rich buff; lower belly and undertail coverts scarlet; tail short, black with a blue tip. Bill black and stout; dark eye; legs pinkish.
art.pose: standing upright on leaf litter, side view
art.scene: Shady evergreen broadleaf forest floor on a southern Korean island in May, dappled light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view standing upright on leaf litter: blackish head with buff crown sides and supercilium, broad black mask through the eye, white throat, stout black bill, green mantle and shoulders, extensive bright blue wing coverts, plain rich buff underparts, red vent, very short tail, long pale pink legs

adult, rear three-quarter view standing with head and body facing the same way: buff crown sides on a blackish head, green mantle and scapulars, extensive bright blue median and greater coverts, black flight feathers, very short tail, pale pink legs
art.build: Plump, almost tailless ground bird, a little larger and heavier-billed than Fairy Pitta (Pitta nympha); large head and upright stance on long legs, with a very short tail. Bill stout, slightly shorter than the head. Legs long and strong, pinkish. Wings rounded. In flight a large white patch shows across the black primaries, and the blue rump and wing coverts flash. Hops on the forest floor, flicking over leaf litter.
avoid: Do not paint chestnut crown sides with a long creamy supercilium and pale whitish-buff underparts; those mark Fairy Pitta (Pitta nympha), the pitta that breeds in Korea.
Do not paint the blue as a small spot; the wing coverts and rump are broadly bright blue.
Do not give it a long tail or a slender bill.
Do not paint a red throat or blue underparts.
